name: sirt6
description: One SIRT6 variant, two cohorts, a trend that reaches significance in neither.
source_references: Sheikholmolouki et al. 2025, Sci Rep 15:40251 (PMID 41249831) — the assigned paper
Hirvonen et al. 2017, BMC Med Genet 18:41 (PMID 28399814) — the primary longevity source it replicates

provenance.adjudicated_by: a bioinformatician reading the diffs between runs
provenance.why: Neither run is the reference. Given a byte-identical prompt they came out complementary rather than ranked: run a agreed on every shared cell while covering a third of the keys, run b covered every key and agreed on a third of the cells. The merge takes run a's studies, licensing and README argument and its C/T row verbatim, and run b's C/C and T/T rows — which do not make the protective claim run a withheld them to avoid — with run b's weights dropped, because no tool fills weight and only a pilot settles it. The human adjudication is what makes this ground truth rather than one more run.
provenance.note: The three digests are what a recompile is checked against; build/ is not committed because a compile is deterministic. artifact_digest moves when the compiler's minor moves and content_signature does not — compare the second across versions.
known_warnings: 1 study quote(s) come from article(s) licensed 'cc by-nc-nd' — the module's real licence constraint, and it should not go away

module declares license 'CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0' but annotation-layer sources report [...] — fired by the machine-written ClinGen row (upstream S77, fixed in 0.7) and itself partly misreported (upstream S79)

tier2_replicated_trend.description: Reported in two independent cohorts with concordant direction, significant in neither. There is no tier 1 here and inventing one would misdescribe the evidence.

decoy_variants.description: Real rsIDs that must not appear. rs2802292 is the interesting one: a genuine longevity variant (FOXO3) that is NOT in this paper, so it catches a run importing general knowledge instead of reading the source it was given. The other two are real variants for unrelated traits.
